title: ReplayTerminationWebhooksRequest
description: Request to replay practitioner.terminated webhooks for already-terminated practitioners

certifyPractitionerIds.description: Practitioners to replay the termination event for. Each must already be terminated; ids with no recorded terminationDate are skipped.

terminationType.description: Termination type to stamp on the replayed events. Optional: `terminationType` is not persisted with the termination, so it cannot be reconstructed. When omitted the replayed payload carries an explicit `null` for this field; every other field is rebuilt from the practitioner's current record.
